findings.description: Direct review of V212 sit and crouch shows the inner layer covering both thighs nearly to the knees, but the outer lilac apron hem still leaves the center of the lap uncovered and forms sharp points beside and between the knees. Reshape the authored front panels so one continuous edged lap spans the flexed thighs.

V212 left and right profiles show the extended apron projecting well ahead of the knees. The prone view folds it back beneath the hips into a long flap with overlapping creases. Reduce forward projection and control the panel transition while keeping clearance and hem continuity.

nextAction: Preserve the inner thigh coverage. Reshape the authored outer apron so its hem follows the raised thighs continuously across the lap, and reduce its forward projection and prone folds. Re-render and directly inspect all five views and six poses. UV remains NOT_CREATED for the body-surface support shell. Fit, production rig/weights, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat behavior, package and release remain unverified.
